EARLY: fewer than 4 observations, fewer than 3 times, under 24h span, or over 48h age
INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 2 observations/times, unresolved identity, or future timestamp
STRONG: at least 8 observations, 5 times, 72h span, latest <=12h, dispersion <=15%
USABLE: at least 4 observations, 3 times, 24h span, meaningful semantics, latest <=24h
rationale: thresholds require independent temporal breadth and resist rapid duplicate checks
